whenToUse: A preschool, nursery or kindergarten with age groups, daily rhythm, fees and open mornings.
Early-years settings that take applications with a live monthly fee.
avoidWhen: Driving or adult courses — use site-course-01.
Schools or public institutions organised by department — use site-department-01.
a11y: Age groups are a keyboard-operable tablist, and the live fee is a role="status" aria-live region.
The play-through animation respects prefers-reduced-motion; keep the timeline readable as static text.
